'''African Risk Capacity Limited''' or simply '''ARC Ltd''', is an African insurer which provides parametric insurance services for climate change and health risks to the [[member states of the African Union]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2021-09-27 |title=African Risk Capacity Ltd first African company to join UN-convened Net-Zero Asset Owner Alliance - Retrieved October 2, 2024</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=KfW & Replica Partners – ARC Replica – InsuResilience Annual Report |url=https://annualreport.insuresilience.org/kfw-replica-partners-arc-replica/ |access-date=2024-02-07 |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Evans |first=Steve |date=2023-09-19 |title=ARC parametric triggers integrated with World Bank social protection in Malawi - Artemis.bm |url=https://www.artemis.bm/news/arc-parametric-triggers-integrated-with-world-bank-social-protection-in-malawi/ |access-date=2024-02-08 |website=Artemis.bm |language=en}}</ref>

In September 2021, ARC Ltd joined the UN-convened [[Net-Zero Asset Owner Alliance]] (NZAOA), a [[United Nations|UN]] initiative of institutional investors committed to transitioning their investment portfolios to net-zero [[Greenhouse gas emissions|GHG emissions]] by 2050, as the first African company to do so.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Members of Net-Zero Asset Owner Alliance |url=https://www.unepfi.org/net-zero-alliance/alliance-members/ |access-date=2024-02-07 |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> On 27 April 2023, in [[Munich]], Germany, ARC Ltd received the Closing the Gap award at the Trading Risk Awards 2023, a recognition of the company’s outbreaks and epidemics insurance products.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Insurance Insider ILS Awards 2023 |url=https://insuranceinsiderils.com/tradingriskawards |access-date=2024-02-08 |website=Insurance Insider ILS |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=The ARC Outbreaks and Epidemics product receives the ‘Closing the Gap Award’ {{!}} African Risk Capacity Group |url=https://www.arc.int/news/arc-outbreaks-and-epidemics-product-receives-closing-gap-award |access-date=2024-02-08 |website=www.arc.int}}</ref>

== History ==
ARC Ltd is a hybrid mutual insurer and financial affiliate of the African Risk Capacity Group. It was established in 2014 with a specific commercial mandate as a [[Bermuda]] Class 2 [[Mutual insurance|mutual insurance company]] with seed capital funding from UK’s [[Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office|Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office]] (FCDO), and Germany’s [[KfW]] through [[Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development|BMZ]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-07-27 |title=Rating report ARC Ltd |url=https://www.fitchratings.com/research/insurance/arc-ltd-27-07-2023 |access-date=2024-02-07 |website=www.fitchratings.com}}</ref> Eventually, ARC Ltd is wholly owned by [[List of sovereign states and dependent territories in Africa|African sovereigns]]. The mandate of ARC Ltd is to create customized [[parametric insurance]] solutions against climate and health risks. Since its inception, ARC Ltd has successfully underwritten ten annual risk pools and is currently [[Africa|Africa’s]] largest provider of parametric insurance.<ref>{{Cite web |title=African Risk Capacity (ARC) {{!}} NDC Partnership |url=https://ndcpartnership.org/knowledge-portal/climate-funds-explorer/african-risk-capacity-arc |access-date=2024-02-08 |website=ndcpartnership.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-12-22 |title=Africa Risk Capacity (ARC) Group Spotlight Interview |url=https://www.indexinsuranceforum.org/blog/africa-risk-capacity-arc-group-spotlight-interview |access-date=2024-02-08 |website=giif |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-06-24 |title=United Nations, IFC, African Risk Capacity, and AAISA Work Towards Creating Disaster Risk Insurance Markets in Africa - World {{!}} ReliefWeb |url=https://reliefweb.int/report/world/united-nations-ifc-african-risk-capacity-and-aaisa-work-towards-creating-disaster-risk |access-date=2024-02-08 |website=reliefweb.int |language=en}}</ref>

== Vision and mission ==
ARC Ltd provides [[parametric insurance]] services to [[member states of the African Union]] and farmer organizations, employing innovative financing mechanisms to pool disaster-related risk across [[Africa]] and transferring it to international risk markets. By transferring the burden of natural disaster risks away from governments and their populations, ARC Ltd facilitates a deliberated response approach to disasters. It disburses financing to fund pre-approved contingency plans to respond rapidly and predictably to disasters.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2016-05-25 |title=AfDB and the African Risk Capacity Agency to work together on response to extreme weather events and natural disasters |url=https://www.afdb.org/fr/news-and-events/afdb-and-the-african-risk-capacity-agency-to-work-together-on-response-to-extreme-weather-events-and-natural-disasters-15730 |access-date=2024-02-08}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Anaesoronye |first=Modestus |date=2022-01-27 |title=Nigeria looks as other countries explore African Risk Capacity for growth |url=https://businessday.ng/news/article/nigeria-looks-as-other-countries-explore-african-risk-capacity-for-growth/ |location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2024-02-08 |newspaper=[[BusinessDay (Nigeria)|BusinessDay]]|language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":1" />

== Leadership ==
Lindelwe Lesley Ndlovu is the chief executive officer at African Risk Capacity "ARC" Limited, and Dr. [[Abdoulie Janneh]] serves as the Chairperson of Board of Directors. Ibrahima Cheik Diong is the Director General of the ARC Group, and Dr. Mothae Anthony Maruping is the chairperson.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Biz |first=Insurance |title=Ten leadership questions for Lesley Ndlovu, CEO, African Risk Capacity Ltd |url=https://insurancebiz.co.za/ten-leadership-questions-for-lesley-ndlovu,-ceo,-african-risk-capacity-ltd.html |access-date=2024-02-08 |website=insurancebiz.co.za |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-06-29 |title=Malawi receives US$14.2 million drought recovery insurance payout - Malawi {{!}} ReliefWeb |url=https://reliefweb.int/report/malawi/malawi-receives-us142-million-drought-recovery-insurance-payout |access-date=2024-02-08 |website=reliefweb.int |language=en}}</ref>

African Risk Capacity Limited or simply ARC Ltd, is an African insurer which provides parametric insurance services for climate change and health risks to the member states of the African Union. ARC Ltd was founded in 2014 as a financial affiliate of the African Risk Capacity (ARC), a specialized agency of the African Union.  As of January 2024, ARC Ltd works as a mutual insurance facility comprising 39 African member countries, and its capital contributors including USAID, SDC, FCDO, KFW/BMZ, IFAD, AFDB, WFP and START NETWORK.
In September 2021, ARC Ltd joined the UN-convened Net-Zero Asset Owner Alliance (NZAOA), a UN initiative of institutional investors committed to transitioning their investment portfolios to net-zero GHG emissions by 2050, as the first African company to do so. On 27 April 2023, in Munich, Germany, ARC Ltd received the Closing the Gap award at the Trading Risk Awards 2023, a recognition of the company’s outbreaks and epidemics insurance products.
